facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.compute_sacrebleu_score: compute a SacrebleuScorer score using corpus_bleu with configurable tokenizer and lowercasing options
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.get_bleu_result_string: get a formatted result string with BLEU score, precision, brevity penalty, and length ratio

facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.create_chrf_scorer: create a ChrFScorer instance to compute character n-gram F-score for translation evaluation
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.add_string_ref_pred: add a reference and prediction string pair to the ChrFScorer for scoring
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.score_chrf_order4: score accumulated reference and prediction pairs using character n-gram F-score with order 4
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.result_string_chrf: get the formatted chrF result object from sacrebleu corpus_chrf for the scorer
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.review_chrf_scorer_class: review the ChrFScorer class that extends BaseScorer and uses sacrebleu for chrF scoring

facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.create_evaluation_tokenizer: create an EvaluationTokenizer with sacreBLEU tokenizer type 13a for text tokenization
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.tokenize_sentence: tokenize a sentence using the EvaluationTokenizer with optional lowercasing and punctuation removal
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.remove_punctuation: remove punctuation from a sentence based on Unicode category using the remove_punctuation class method
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.tokenize_with_character_mode: tokenize text into individual characters using the EvaluationTokenizer with character tokenization enabled
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.review_tokenizer_types: review the available sacreBLEU tokenizer types including none, 13a, intl, zh, and ja-mecab

facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.create_WerScorer: create a WerScorer instance with a WerScorerConfig to compute word error rate
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.add_string_WerScorer: add a reference and prediction string pair to the WerScorer for WER calculation
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.score_WerScorer: compute the word error rate score as a percentage from accumulated string pairs
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.reset_WerScorer: reset the WerScorer distance and reference length counters to zero
facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/.result_string_WerScorer: get a formatted WER result string with the score rounded to two decimal places
